evidence.detail: Builds a full HTML anchor string with f-string and stores as signed_up_msg_safe
Uses triple-mustache {{{signed_up_msg_safe}}} to avoid HTML-escaping the raw HTML string; the _safe naming is a convention indicating 'trust me, no escaping'

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/views/signup.py: replace the f-string assignment with three separate attributes: self.already_signed_up = True, self.deck_url = deck_url, self.deck_name = d.name, self.retire_url = retire_url. In decksite/templates/signup.mustache: add a {{#already_signed_up}} section that constructs {{deck_name}} and Retire? using normal double-mustache (auto-escaped) instead of the triple-mustache. This removes the _safe pattern entirely.
triage.notes: The refactor is purely cosmetic/structural; the URLs themselves should be auto-generated by url_for and are safe. No behavioral change, no data migration.
